title: Not worth it
text: I've been using InShot for YEARS and it keeps getting worse. It freezes, and when you try to export/download old videos, it gets stuck processing indefinitely even if you have all the videos saved in your camera roll. I really tried to keep using it, but the issues with exporting are exhausting. Edits is infinitely better, plus it’s free. I’ve also noticed that the video quality drops when I edit with InShot compared to Edits even if I export at 4K. The fonts aren't as nice, and the transitions feel outdated. It used to be really good, but right now, it's just not worth it.
